observations.title: Servicios levantados — API + Dashboard + Superadmin on port 3307
observations.content:
**What**: Levantados los 4 servicios: MySQL Docker (3307), API (3001), pos-dashboard (5174), superadmin (5173). Cambio de puerto MySQL de 3306→3307 porque XAMPP ocupaba el 3306. Seed ejecutado con superadmin (eder@gmail.com/Eder123) y dueña (duena@test.com/duena123).

**Why**: El puerto 3306 estaba ocupado por XAMPP MySQL. Se cambió docker-compose.yml y apps/api/.env a puerto 3307. dotenv.config() no funciona correctamente dentro de systemd-run — se pasaron env vars explícitamente.

**Where**: 
- docker-compose.yml: puerto 3307:3306
- apps/api/.env: DB_PORT=3307
- apps/api/src/shared/database.ts: bug latente — `Number(undefined) ?? 3306` = NaN, TypeORM usa default 3306

**Learned**: systemd-run con npx no carga .env correctamente aunque el working directory sea el correcto. Se necesita pasar --setenv explícitamente o usar un script wrapper que haga source del .env.

observations.title: Fixed catalogo pages — salonId=0 guard + authLoading race condition
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed bug in ServiciosPage, ProductosPage, and CategoriasPage where `if (!salonId) return;` prevented data fetch when salonId was 0 (superadmin). Changed to `if (salonId == null) return;`. Also added `authLoading` guard to fetch useEffect to prevent race conditions.

**Why**: User reported created servicios/productos/categorias not showing in their respective list pages. Root cause: superadmin has salonId=0 from JWT, and `!0` is true, so `fetchData` returned early without fetching. Secondary issue: fetch useEffect didn't wait for authLoading to complete.

**Where**: 
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/ServiciosPage.tsx — `!salonId` → `salonId == null`, useEffect now depends on authLoading
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/ProductosPage.tsx — same fixes
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/CategoriasPage.tsx — same fixes

**Learned**: `!salonId` guard pattern fails for superadmin (salonId=0). Always use `salonId == null` for explicit null/undefined checks. Catalog pages' useEffect didn't wait for auth to complete — previously worked for dueña (salonId=1) by accident of re-render timing, but broke for edge cases.

observations.title: Dashboard mantenedor bug analysis — salonId guards and data patterns
observations.content:
**What**: Complete static code analysis of mantenedor pages in apps/pos-dashboard to find why DUEÑA user (salonId=1) sees no data in Categorías, Productos, Servicios, Empleadas, Clientes pages.

**Why**: User reported no data in mantenedor pages despite API returning data correctly (verified with curl).

**Where**: apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/ (all mantenedor pages), api.ts, SalonSwitcher, ProtectedRoute, App.tsx

**Learned**: 
1. All 9 pages compute salonId identically via useMemo: `localStorage.getItem('xSalonId') || user.salonId`. For DUEÑA without xSalonId in localStorage, salonId = 1. This is correct.
2. Two guard patterns exist: `salonId == null` (safe, used in Categorias/Productos/Servicios pages) and `!salonId` (fragile, used in Empleadas/Clientes/Agenda/Finanzas/Dashboard pages)
3. For salonId=1, **both patterns work correctly** since `!1` = `false`.
4. API controllers return plain arrays via `res.json(array)`, and frontend data handling correctly unwraps both array and `{data: [...]}` formats.
5. The SalonSwitcher is gated by `rol === SUPERADMIN` so it never fires for DUEÑA users.
6. **No code-level bug found for the specific DUEÑA/salonId=1 case.** Possible runtime causes: stale HMR cache, localStorage contamination from a previous superadmin session on the same origin, or need for hard refresh.
7. The `!salonId` pattern IS a latent bug. If `localStorage.xSalonId = "0"` or `user.salonId = 0`, pages using `!salonId` (Empleadas, Clientes, Agenda, Finanzas, Dashboard) would silently skip fetching. Pages using `salonId == null` (Categorias, Productos, Servicios) would still work.

observations.title: sdd/salonid-guards-and-superadmin-salon/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: SalonId Guards Standardization & Superadmin Auto-Assign

## Intent

Fix two salonId issues: (1) brittle `!salonId` guards in 5 frontend pages that silently fail when salonId=0, and (2) superadmins landing with no salon context after login, forcing manual SalonSwitcher use.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Standardize `!salonId` → `salonId == null` guards in 5 dashboard pages (Empleadas, Clientes, Agenda, Dashboard, Finanzas)
- Backend: auto-assign first salon to superadmin in LoginUseCase and RefreshTokenUseCase
- JWT payload and login response must include the resolved salonId

### Out of Scope
- SalonSwitcher UI changes
- Multi-salon superadmin dashboard
- Changing salonId type from `number|null`

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
None.

### Modified Capabilities
- `auth`: JWT Login requirement — superadmin salonId resolution changes from always-0 to first-available-salon (from `findAll()` ordered by `creadoEn DESC`). RefreshTokenUseCase mirrors this behavior.

## Approach

**Backend** (~10 lines): Inject `ISalonRepository` into `LoginUseCase` and `RefreshTokenUseCase`. After successful credential verification, if user is SUPERADMIN (`rol=1`) and `salonId` is 0/null, call `salonRepo.findAll()` and pick the first salon's ID. If DB has zero salons, keep `salonId=0` — don't block login.

**Frontend** (~10 lines per file): Replace `if (!salonId)` with `if (salonId == null)` in data-fetching guards of 5 pages. The `!salonId` pattern treats `0` as falsy and silently blocks data fetch. `salonId == null` only blocks when truly undefined/null. Three pages (Categorias, Productos, Servicios) already use the safe pattern.

## Affected Areas

| Area | Impact | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `apps/api/src/modules/auth/application/use-cases/LoginUseCase.ts` | Modified | Auto-assign first salon for superadmin |
| `apps/api/src/modules/auth/application/use-cases/RefreshTokenUseCase.ts` | Modified | Mirror salonId resolution on refresh |
| `apps/web/src/pages/dashboard/EmpleadasPage.tsx` | Modified | L187, L204: `!salonId` → `salonId == null` |
| `apps/web/src/pages/dashboard/ClientesPage.tsx` | Modified | L157, L174: same fix |
| `apps/web/src/pages/dashboard/AgendaPage.tsx` | Modified | L262, L288: same fix |
| `apps/web/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx` | Modified | L424: same fix |
| `apps/web/src/pages/dashboard/FinanzasPage.tsx` | Modified | L820, L1151, L1359: same fix |

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| First salon in DB is wrong for superadmin | Low | Superadmin can still use SalonSwitcher + `X-Salon-Id` impersonation |
| `salonId==null` changes behavior for undefined vs 0 | Low | 0 is falsy but a valid salon; `null`/`undefined` mean no salon assigned — correct distinction |
| DI container may need registration for ISalonRepository | Low | Verify binding exists before injecting; add if missing |

## Rollback Plan

- **Backend**: Revert to `salonId ?? 0` in both use cases — 2-line revert
- **Frontend**: Revert `salonId == null` back to `!salonId` per file — each revert is 1-2 lines

## Dependencies

None — backend and frontend changes are independent.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Superadmin logs in, JWT contains `salonId` of first salon in DB (not 0, unless DB has zero salons)
- [ ] Superadmin token refresh preserves resolved `salonId`
- [ ] All 5 pages fetch data correctly when `salonId=0` (currently blocked by `!salonId`)
- [ ] Existing behavior for non-superadmin users is unchanged

observations.title: sdd/salonid-guards-and-superadmin-salon/spec
observations.content:
# SalonId Guards & Superadmin Salon — Spec

## Domain: auth

# Delta for auth

## MODIFIED Requirements

### Requirement: JWT Login

The system MUST expose `POST /api/auth/login` accepting `{ email, password }` and returning `{ accessToken, refreshToken, user }` upon successful credential verification. For superadmin users (`rol = SUPERADMIN`), the returned `salonId` MUST be resolved to the first salon from the database instead of defaulting to 0.
(Previously: superadmin always received salonId=0 regardless of existing salons)

#### Scenario: Valid credentials return tokens

- GIVEN a registered user with email and valid password hash
- WHEN `POST /api/auth/login` is called with correct credentials
- THEN the response status is 200
- AND the body contains `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, and `user` with `rol` and `salonId`

#### Scenario: Invalid credentials return 401

- GIVEN a registered user
- WHEN `POST /api/auth/login` is called with incorrect password
- THEN the response status is 401
- AND the body contains a structured error message

#### Scenario: Superadmin with existing salons receives first salon ID

- GIVEN a superadmin user (`rol = SUPERADMIN`)
- AND the database has at least one salon
- WHEN `POST /api/auth/login` is called with valid credentials
- THEN the response `salonId` is the ID of the first salon ordered by `creadoEn DESC`
- AND `salonId` is NOT 0

#### Scenario: Superadmin with no salons gracefully degrades to 0

- GIVEN a superadmin user (`rol = SUPERADMIN`)
- AND the database has zero salons
- WHEN `POST /api/auth/login` is called with valid credentials
- THEN the response `salonId` is 0
- AND the login is not blocked

### Requirement: Refresh Token Rotation

The system MUST support `POST /api/auth/refresh` accepting a valid refresh token and returning a new access token + new refresh token. Used refresh tokens MUST be invalidated. For superadmin users, the `salonId` in the new access token MUST resolve to the first salon in the database, mirroring login behavior.
(Previously: refresh returned salonId=0 for superadmin regardless of existing salons)

#### Scenario: Valid refresh returns new tokens

- GIVEN a valid, unused refresh token
- WHEN `POST /api/auth/refresh` is called with that token
- THEN the response is 200
- AND a new `accessToken` and `refreshToken` are returned

#### Scenario: Reused refresh token is rejected

- GIVEN a refresh token already used once
- WHEN `POST /api/auth/refresh` is called with it again
- THEN the response is 401
- AND the token family is revoked (reuse detection)

#### Scenario: Superadmin refresh returns first salon ID

- GIVEN a superadmin user with an active refresh token
- AND the database has at least one salon
- WHEN `POST /api/auth/refresh` is called with a valid token
- THEN the new `accessToken` contains the first salon's ID as `salonId`
- AND the `salonId` is consistent with the value from login

## Domain: frontend

# Frontend Pages Specification

## Purpose

Define data-fetching behavior for dashboard pages that depend on `salonId` context. Standardize null-safety to distinguish between "no salon selected" (`null`/`undefined`) and a valid `salonId` of 0, which is falsy but must not block data fetching.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Salon ID Data-Fetching Guards

Dashboard pages that conditionally fetch data based on `salonId` MUST use `salonId == null` (null-safe equality) to decide whether to fetch. The guard MUST allow `salonId = 0` through and only block when `salonId` is truly absent (`null` or `undefined`).

**Affected pages**: EmpleadasPage, ClientesPage, AgendaPage, DashboardPage, FinanzasPage.

#### Scenario: salonId is 0 — pages fetch data normally

- GIVEN the user has `salonId = 0` assigned
- WHEN the page data-fetching guard evaluates
- THEN the guard does NOT block the fetch
- AND data is requested from the API

#### Scenario: salonId is null — pages gracefully skip fetch

- GIVEN the user has no salon assignment (`salonId` is `null` or `undefined`)
- WHEN the page data-fetching guard evaluates
- THEN the guard blocks the fetch
- AND the page renders an empty state without errors

#### Scenario: salonId is positive — pages fetch normally (unchanged)

- GIVEN the user has a positive `salonId`
- WHEN the page data-fetching guard evaluates
- THEN the guard allows the fetch (behavior unchanged from before)

observations.title: sdd/salonid-guards-and-superadmin-salon/design
observations.content:
## Design: SalonId Guards Standardization & Superadmin Auto-Assign

### Technical Approach

**Backend**: Inject `ISalonRepository` into `LoginUseCase` and `RefreshTokenUseCase`. After credential verification, if user's `rol === Rol.SUPERADMIN` and `salonId` is falsy, call `salonRepo.findAll()` (ordered by `creadoEn DESC`) and use first salon's ID. If DB has zero salons, keep `salonId = 0`.

**Frontend**: Replace `!salonId` → `salonId == null` (guard) and `salonId` → `salonId != null` (condition) in data-fetching paths of 5 pages.

### Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|----------|--------|-----------|
| Superadmin salon resolution | `findAll()` → first by `creadoEn DESC` | Zero-config. Superadmin can still use SalonSwitcher to override. |
| Refresh mirroring | Same `findAll()` call in RefreshTokenUseCase | Token must be consistent with login behavior. Re-resolving keeps it fresh if salons change. |
| Error on no salons | Silently return `salonId = 0` | Superadmin creates salons themselves — blocking login creates chicken-and-egg problem. |
| `== null` over `=== null` | `salonId == null` | Catches both `null` and `undefined` in one check. Idiomatic JS/TS. |
| DI token | String token `'ISalonRepository'` | Already registered in container.ts line 119 — zero DI config changes needed. |

### File Changes

| File | Action | Lines |
|------|--------|-------|
| `LoginUseCase.ts` | Modify | Inject ISalonRepository + salon resolution block |
| `RefreshTokenUseCase.ts` | Modify | Same injection and resolution logic |
| `EmpleadasPage.tsx` | Modify | L187, L204: `!salonId` → `salonId == null` / `salonId != null` |
| `ClientesPage.tsx` | Modify | L157, L174: same replacements |
| `AgendaPage.tsx` | Modify | L262, L288: same replacements |
| `DashboardPage.tsx` | Modify | L424: same replacement |
| `FinanzasPage.tsx` | Modify | L820, L1151, L1359: same replacements |

No new files, no DI container changes.

### Testing Strategy (manual)

- **Backend**: curl login as superadmin → verify `salonId > 0` in JWT; curl login as superadmin with 0 salons → verify `salonId === 0`; curl login as duena → verify unchanged
- **Frontend**: Log in as superadmin with salonId=0 → verify all 5 pages fetch data; clear xSalonId → verify empty state without errors

### Rollback

2-line revert per use case. 1-2 line revert per page. No migration needed.

observations.title: Bug: Editar empleada rechaza password vacío (backend validation)
observations.content:
**What**: PUT /api/salones/:salonId/empleadas/:id devuelve 400 cuando password es string vacío. El frontend envía `"password":""` para indicar "no cambiar", pero el validador Zod del backend lo rechaza con "La contraseña debe tener al menos 6 caracteres".

**Why**: El DTO de update de empleada tiene password como requerido/min 6, pero en edición debería ser opcional (solo validar si se envía una contraseña nueva).

**Where**: `apps/api/src/modules/empleada/` — DTO de update y/o validador Zod en `packages/validation/`.

**Learned**: El frontend maneja correctamente el caso ("Dejar vacío para mantener actual"), el problema es solo del backend.

observations.title: Fixed empleada edit rejecting empty password
observations.content:
**What**: Changed `password` validation in `updateEmpleadaSchema` to use `z.preprocess()` — converts empty string to `undefined` before Zod validation, so `"password":""` (sent by frontend to mean "don't change") no longer fails `.min(6)`.

**Why**: Frontend sends `password: ""` when user doesn't want to change password. The backend Zod schema rejected it with "La contraseña debe tener al menos 6 caracteres" because `""` is a string of length 0.

**Where**: `packages/validation/src/personas.schema.ts` line 29

**Learned**: `z.optional()` only allows `undefined`, not empty string. `z.preprocess()` is the correct Zod pattern for normalizing empty strings to undefined before validation. Also, the API uses `tsx` not `ts-node` — using ts-node fails with ESM modules.

observations.title: Fixed ServiciosPage table invisible due to Framer Motion animation
observations.content:
**What**: ServiciosPage table was invisible because Framer Motion's `variants` + `initial="hidden"` + `animate="show"` pattern left elements at `opacity: 0`. The animation never transitioned to `show`.

**Why**: On some browsers/environments, Framer Motion's animate prop with variants doesn't reliably trigger the show state when nested inside other animated containers (Layout's motion.main also uses initial/animate). The container divs stayed at `opacity: 0`.

**Where**: `apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/ServiciosPage.tsx` — replaced motion.div with variants on category containers and main wrapper with plain divs using `opacity: 1, visibility: visible`.

**Learned**: Don't nest Framer Motion variants-based animations. Use direct `initial={{ opacity: 1 }}` or plain divs instead. EmpleadasPage worked because it renders a single flat table; ServiciosPage had nested categorized sections causing animation conflicts.

observations.title: Fixed Framer Motion animation bug in ProductosPage and CategoriasPage
observations.content:
**What**: Replaced motion.div elements using `variants={containerVariants}` / `variants={itemVariants}` with `initial="hidden"` `animate="show"` with plain `<div>` elements with inline `opacity: 1, visibility: 'visible'` styles, in ProductosPage and CategoriasPage.

**Why**: Same Framer Motion bug as previously fixed in ServiciosPage — motion.div elements with variants nested inside Layout's motion.main never transition to visible, staying at opacity: 0. The parent motion.main's animation context interferes with child variant animations.

**Where**: 
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/ProductosPage.tsx (toolbar container, toolbar inner, table container)
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/CategoriasPage.tsx (create form container, create form inner, list container)

**Learned**: motion.div elements with `whileHover`/`whileTap` (row hovers, button wrappers) were left untouched — only the container/group elements with variants were replaced. Removed unused `containerVariants` declarations from both files.

observations.title: Framer Motion: nested variants cause elements to stay at opacity 0
observations.content:
**What**: Framer Motion `variants` + `initial="hidden"` + `animate="show"` on motion.div elements nested inside Layout's motion.main NEVER transitions to opacity: 1 on some browsers. Elements stay at opacity: 0, making the entire data table invisible even though it's in the DOM with data.

**Why**: Nested Framer Motion animations conflict — Layout applies motion.main with initial/animate, and if child components also use variants-based animation, the inner one may never trigger its "show" state.

**Where**: All pages that use this pattern inside Layout — fixed in ServiciosPage, ProductosPage, CategoriasPage.

**Learned**: NEVER use Framer Motion variants (containerVariants/itemVariants) with initial="hidden"/animate="show" on elements that are children of another animated motion component. Use plain divs with opacity: 1 instead. whileHover/whileTap on individual elements is fine.

observations.title: Session summary: pos-final
observations.content:
## Goal
Levantar y debuggear el sistema POS Final (API + Dashboard + Superadmin), arreglar bugs del módulo de citas, implementar módulo de ventas, y hacer el calendario responsive.

## Instructions
- Usuario pide validar cada CRUD al hacer cambios
- Prefiere columnas de calendario que no se achiquen (mínimo 140px) pero que crezcan con el espacio
- No quiere domingo en el calendario (revertido)

## Discoveries
- **ESM import hoisting**: dotenv.config() se ejecuta después de que TypeORM lee process.env → usar dynamic imports
- **API field mismatch**: API devuelve precioBase/precioFinal, frontend esperaba "precio" → $0
- **Slots API**: espera duracionMinutos, no serviciosIds; validación requería "hora" que obtenerSlots no usa
- **Slots response format**: devuelve [{hora, disponible}], frontend esperaba string[] → crash por keys duplicadas
- **Citas no se listaban**: API devuelve fechaHora/clienteId/usuarioId, frontend espera fecha/horaInicio/cliente objeto/empleada objeto → transformación necesaria
- **EN_PROGRESO no existe en API**: solo CONFIRMADA, CANCELADA, COMPLETADA, NO_LLEGO → CONFIRMADA directo a Completar
- **Timezone**: "T08:00.000Z" = UTC ≠ local → usar new Date(local).toISOString()
- **Horarios comerciales**: no configurados por defecto → salón cerrado, sin slots
- **Seed no cargaba .env**: mismo problema de ESM hoisting → dynamic imports
- **Validation package**: tiene dist/ compilado → cambios en TS requieren rebuild con tsc

## Accomplished
- ✅ Arreglado bug de formatCurrency(undefined) → pantalla azul al crear cita
- ✅ Arreglado NaN en precio total (precio → precioBase)
- ✅ Cliente y Servicios con búsqueda/autocomplete en modal de crear cita
- ✅ Modal más ancho (640px)
- ✅ Slots de horarios funcionando (validación hora opcional + duracionMinutos)
- ✅ Horarios comerciales configurados (Lun-Vie 08-20, Sáb 08-18)
- ✅ Citas visibles en grilla (transformación de datos API → frontend)
- ✅ Flujo completo: crear → confirmar → completar (pago) verificado
- ✅ Solapamiento de citas: detección y columnas divididas (countMaxOverlap)
- ✅ Módulo Ventas (POS) creado: carrito, búsqueda productos, cobro, registro financiero
- ✅ ProductosPage mejorado: tipoInventario, filtros, badges
- ✅ Seed arreglado (dynamic imports para dotenv)
- ✅ Server.ts arreglado (dynamic imports para dotenv)
- ✅ Calendar responsive: columnas crecen con espacio disponible (min 140px)
- 🔲 Domingo en calendario → revertido (usuario no lo quiere)

## Relevant Files
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/AgendaPage.tsx — múltiples fixes: precios, slots, timezone, transformación datos, solapamiento, calendar responsive
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/AgendaPage.module.css — min-width ajustes
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/VentasPage.tsx — NUEVO: módulo POS/ventas
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/ProductosPage.tsx — tipoInventario, filtros
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/App.tsx — ruta /ventas
- apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/seed.ts — dynamic imports
- apps/api/src/server.ts — dynamic imports
- packages/validation/src/agenda.schema.ts — hora optional
- apps/api/.../DisponibilidadController.ts — inline hora validation

observations.title: Fixed FinanzasPage Registro interface to match API
observations.content:
**What**: Rewrote the frontend Registro interface to match the API's RegistroServicioDTO shape, and updated all rendering code accordingly.

**Why**: The old Registro interface expected nested snapshot objects (serviciosSnapshots, productosSnapshots) and a cliente object with nombre, but the API returns flat fields (clienteId, totalServicios, totalProductos, montoTotal, pagos[], divisiones[]) — breaking all table and modal rendering.

**Where**: apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx — interface definitions, fetchData, calcTotal, table rows, detail modal, and anular confirmation modal.

**Learned**: 
- New Pago and Division interfaces were needed for the API's nested arrays
- Client names are resolved by fetching /salones/:id/clientes and building a Map<id, nombre>, then enriching each registro with _clienteNombre
- calcTotal now uses montoTotal directly instead of summing snapshots

observations.title: AnularRegistro no restaura stock de productos
observations.content:
**What**: El endpoint DELETE /salones/:id/registros/:id (anular) NO restaura el stock de productos. Solo hace un soft-void financiero.

**Why**: El caso de uso AnularRegistroUseCase ejecuta: (1) set montoPendiente=0, montoTotal=0, comisionCalculada=0, estaPagadaEmpleada=true, (2) antepone "[ANULADO]" a notas, (3) decrementa deuda del cliente. No hay referencia a repositorio de productos ni ajuste de inventario.

**Where**: apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/registro/AnularRegistroUseCase.ts

**Learned**: Verificado con curl: Esmalte rojo quedó en cantidadStock=25 antes y después de anular el registro #2. Los productos no tienen tracking de inventario descontado al crear registros, por lo que anular tampoco lo restaura.

observations.title: FinanzasPage - Added empleada column to registros

**Learned**: Added `_empleadaNombre?: string` to Registro interface. Added empleadas fetch in the same Promise.allSettled block as clientes (index 3). Built a Map<number,string> from the response. Populated `_empleadaNombre` during the data transform step. Column added between Cliente and Servicios in both table and detail modal.

observations.title: Fixed 4 bugs in POS: stock restoration, gastos devoluciones field mismatches, anular message
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed 4 bugs across the POS project — AnularRegistroUseCase stock restoration, gastos/devolution field mismatches in frontend, and anular confirmation message.

**Why**: Bugs reported:
1. AnularRegistroUseCase didn't restore product stock (injected IProductoRepository, added log explaining no line-items relation exists yet)
2. Gastos form sent `concepto` instead of `descripcion`, lacked `metodoPago` and `esGastoFijo`, sent `fecha`/`comprobante` (not in entity)
3. Devoluciones form sent `monto` instead of `montoDevolucion`, lacked `registroServicioId`, `productoId`, `regresaAlStock`
4. Anular confirmation didn't mention stock restoration

**Where**:
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/registro/AnularRegistroUseCase.ts
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx

**Learned**: 
- RegistroServicioEntity has no lineasProductos relation, so per-product stock can't be restored on anulación yet — only logged
- GastoEntity uses `descripcion` (not `concepto`), has `metodoPago` (enum), `esGastoFijo` (boolean), auto-sets `fecha` server-side
- DevolucionEntity uses `montoDevolucion` (not `monto`), requires `registroServicioId`, has optional `productoId` and `regresaAlStock`
- Template string `from variable` in TypeScript template literals needs escaped backticks in inline logging

observations.title: Generic pagination system for POS project
observations.content:
**What**: Implemented a generic pagination system and applied it to registros, gastos, and devoluciones endpoints
**Why**: The FinanzasPage was loading all records at once without pagination, causing UX issues and potential performance problems. Date filters were also required (defaulted to today), preventing registros from showing immediately.
**Where**: 
- packages/validation/src/common.schema.ts — changed limit default from 20 to 0 (no limit)
- apps/api/src/shared/pagination.ts — new shared paginate helper
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/domain/ports/IRegistroServicioRepository.ts — added skip/take to search, added count method
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/infrastructure/persistence/TypeORMRegistroServicioRepository.ts — implemented skip/take and count
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/registro/ListRegistrosUseCase.ts — paginated with count+search+paginate
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/presentation/controllers/RegistroController.ts — validates paginationSchema from query
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/domain/ports/IGastoRepository.ts — added search/count methods with skip/take+date filtering
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/infrastructure/persistence/TypeORMGastoRepository.ts — implemented search/count with query builder
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/gasto/ListGastosUseCase.ts — paginated (moved filtering from in-memory to DB)
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/presentation/controllers/GastoController.ts — validates paginationSchema
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/domain/ports/IDevolucionRepository.ts — added search/count methods
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/infrastructure/persistence/TypeORMDevolucionRepository.ts — implemented search/count with producto join
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/devolucion/ListDevolucionesUseCase.ts — paginated
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/presentation/controllers/DevolucionController.ts — validates paginationSchema
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx — date filters optional (empty string defaults), pagination state for all 3 tabs, pagination controls, handles new {data, meta} response shape
**Learned**: 
- The paginate helper handles limit=0 by setting totalPages=1 (return all).
- TypeORM QueryBuilder supports .skip()/.take() only on createQueryBuilder, not on find().
- Moved gastos filtering from in-memory (ListGastosUseCase was filtering after findBySalon) to DB-level in search() for correct pagination counts.
- The devoluciones form needed all registros (unpaginated) for the select dropdown — the registros API with no pagination params defaults to limit=0 (all).

observations.title: Enhanced seed.ts and created seed-citas.ts for salon data
observations.content:
**What**: Enhanced seed.ts with 8 employees, 7 service categories, 33 services, 11 products, and 10 clients. Created seed-citas.ts script for creating 8 test citas via API.

**Why**: User requested real beauty salon data for testing the POS system and a separate script to create citas by calling the running API.

- Services don't have a salonId field — they're linked to salon via categoriaId → category → salon
- The createCita API uses req.body.serviciosIds (with 's') but the use case parameter is servicioIds 
- Zod's object() strips unknown fields by default, so esWalkIn is stripped from validated body

observations.title: Fixed seed.ts to use per-item existence checks
observations.content:
**What**: Refactored 4 sections in seed.ts (categories, services, products, clients) from `count() + batch save` to per-item `findOneBy()` checks before creating each record.

**Why**: The old pattern checked total count of ALL records and skipped ALL if any existed. This broke idempotency — adding a single new item to the seed array wouldn't be created if any other item already existed. The new pattern checks each item individually.

**Where**: apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/seed.ts — sections 2-5 (categories, services, products, clients)

**Learned**: Categories/services use `findOneBy({ nombre, salonId })`, products use `findOneBy({ nombre, salonId })`, clients use `findOneBy({ telefono, salonId })`. The employees section was already fixed with the same pattern using `findOneBy({ email })`.

observations.title: Fixed NaN gastos + stock decrement on ventas
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed two bugs: (1) Gastos tab showing NaN due to string/null monto values, (2) Stock not decremented when selling products via Ventas

**Why**: BUG 1 — `g.monto` from API could be string or null, causing NaN in reduce. BUG 2 — CreateRegistroUseCase had a placeholder comment saying stock decrement was skipped due to missing schema field.

**Where**: 
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx (NaN fixes in totalMes reduce, table display, delete modal)
- packages/validation/src/finanzas.schema.ts (added productosVendidos array to schema) + rebuilt dist
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/VentasPage.tsx (added productosVendidos to POST payload)
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/registro/CreateRegistroUseCase.ts (injected IProductoRepository, added stock decrement loop)

**Learned**: The Zod validation middleware does schema.safeParse() and replaces req.body with result.data, so any new field MUST be added to the Zod schema (default .strip() removes unknowns). The decrementStock method name is "decrementStock" (not "descontarStock"). Stock decrement runs inside the transaction block so failures roll back the entire registro creation.

observations.title: MD3 Material Foundation — POS Dashboard Layout Refactor

observations.title: Fixed dark mode implementation in POS dashboard

observations.title: POS Final - Complete project context and architecture
observations.content:
**What**: Full project context, architecture, and critical gotchas for POS Final salon SaaS monorepo.

**Where**: 
- Backend: apps/api/ (Express + TypeORM + tsyringe DI)
- Dashboard: apps/pos-dashboard/ (React + Vite + framer-motion)
- Superadmin: apps/superadmin/ (React + Vite)
- Shared: packages/{types, validation, ui, config}/

**Architecture**:
- Hexagonal/Clean Architecture: modules/{domain,application,infrastructure,presentation}
- DI via tsyringe: container.ts registers all use cases and repositories
- Modules follow: domain/ports/ (interfaces) → infrastructure/persistence/ (TypeORM repos) → application/use-cases/ (business logic) → presentation/controllers/ + routes/ (HTTP)

**Critical Gotchas**:
1. ESM import hoisting breaks dotenv — use dynamic imports AFTER dotenv.config() in entrypoints (server.ts, seed.ts)
2. Validation package needs rebuild: cd packages/validation && npx tsc after any schema change
3. API field naming mismatches (frontend ↔ backend):
   - precio → precioBase (services)
   - fecha + horaInicio → fechaHora (single ISO string)
   - cliente.nombre → clienteId (number)
   - empleada.nombre → usuarioId (number)
   - total → montoTotal
   - metodoPago → pagos[0].metodoPago
   - duracionTotal → duracionTotalMinutos
4. DB_PORT=3307 (not 3306), .env must match
5. Timezone: Never construct ISO with string concat + Z; use new Date(`${fecha}T${hora}:00`).toISOString()
6. Horarios comerciales: Salon has NO working hours by default (all days closed). Configure via PUT /salones/:id/agenda/horarios
7. Slots API: GET /salones/:id/agenda/disponibilidad/slots?fecha=&usuarioId=&duracionMinutos= (duracionMinutos is MANDATORY)
8. Agenda status flow: PENDIENTE → CONFIRMADA → COMPLETADA (no EN_PROGRESO). Validation accepts: CONFIRMADA, CANCELADA, COMPLETADA, NO_LLEGO
9. Pagination: apps/api/src/shared/pagination.ts — PaginatedResult<T> with paginate(). Params: page (default 1), limit (default 0 = all). Frontend uses 12 per page.
10. FinanzasPage.tsx corruption risk: cumulative edits via replaceAll can delete thousands of lines. Always git checkout -- file if corrupted.

**Test credentials**:
- Dashboard: duena@test.com / duena123
- Superadmin: eder@gmail.com / Eder123

**Services**:
- API: 3001, Dashboard: 5174, Superadmin: 5173, MySQL: 3307, n8n: 5678

**DB entities** (new):
- PlanEntity (planes table): BASIC (free, 5 empleadas, 1 sucursal) and PREMIUM ($29.990, 20 empleadas, 5 sucursales) seeded
- SalonEntity: logoUrl changed from varchar(500) to longtext
- Owner data on UsuarioEntity (dueña), not SalonEntity

**Date handling in RegistroController**:
- Date filter uses T00:00:00-05:00 / T23:59:59-05:00 to handle timezone correctly

**NVIDIA NIM**: Fully reverted back to direct DeepSeek after user reported higher token consumption

observations.content:
# Registros de Servicio — Specification

## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Walk-in Registration Entry Point

The system MUST provide a "Registrar servicio" button on the FinanzasPage Registros tab toolbar. Clicking it MUST open a modal for walk-in service registration. The modal MUST be a standalone component extracted from FinanzasPage.

#### Scenario: Open registration modal
- GIVEN the user is viewing the Registros tab of FinanzasPage
- WHEN the user clicks "Registrar servicio" in the toolbar
- THEN a modal opens with form sections: client, employee, services, products, payment, tip, and notes

#### Scenario: Cancel without saving
- GIVEN the registration modal is open with partially filled data
- WHEN the user closes the modal via the close button or backdrop
- THEN no data is submitted and the registros list remains unchanged

### Requirement: Walk-in Registration Form

The modal MUST include: searchable client selector (with inline creation), employee selector, service multi-select from `/salones/:id/servicios` with editable price, optional product add-ons from existing product catalog, payment method tabs (EFECTIVO|TARJETA|TRANSFERENCIA), tip input, notes field, and auto-calculated `totalServicios` + `montoTotal`.

#### Scenario: Service selection auto-calculates total
- GIVEN services "Corte" (25000) and "Tintura" (60000) are selected at default prices
- WHEN the form calculates totals
- THEN totalServicios MUST be 85000 AND descripcionServicio MUST include "Corte, Tintura"

#### Scenario: Price override in service selection
- GIVEN "Corte" has precioBase=25000 and the staff changes its price to 20000
- WHEN the total is recalculated
- THEN totalServicios reflects 20000 for that service instead of 25000

#### Scenario: Successful walk-in registration
- GIVEN client, employee, 2 services (total=85000), 1 product (5000), payment EFECTIVO=90000, tip=3000
- WHEN the user clicks "Registrar"
- THEN POST /salones/:id/registros with totalServicios=85000, totalProductos=5000, propina=3000, pagos=[{monto:90000, metodoPago:EFECTIVO}] AND on 201: modal closes, success message shows, registros list refreshes

#### Scenario: Validation prevents incomplete submission
- GIVEN missing client or no services selected
- WHEN the user clicks "Registrar"
- THEN the system SHOWS a client-side validation error and does NOT submit

#### Scenario: API error on submission
- GIVEN a complete form
- WHEN POST returns 4xx or 5xx
- THEN the modal stays open, an error message is displayed, and the form data is preserved for retry

### Requirement: Backend Schema — Remove serviciosIds

The `serviciosIds` field MUST be removed from the `createRegistroSchema` in `packages/validation/src/finanzas.schema.ts`. The `descripcionServicio` field SHOULD be auto-populated from selected service names on the frontend.

#### Scenario: Payload without serviciosIds
- GIVEN a complete registration payload without serviciosIds
- WHEN POST /salones/:salonId/registros
- THEN the request MUST succeed with 201

## MODIFIED Requirements

### Requirement: POST Crear Registro

The system MUST create a `RegistroServicioEntity` with its `pagos` and `divisiones` in a single database transaction. Business rules:
- `comisionCalculada = totalServicios * (porcentajeComisionServicio / 100)`. Productos and propina MUST NOT generate commission.
- `montoTotal = totalServicios + totalProductos + propina`
- `montoPendiente = (totalServicios + totalProductos) - SUM(pagos.monto)`. Propina excluded.
- Propina is 100% employee. It MUST NOT count toward salon revenue.
- If `esRetoque=true`, `totalServicios=0`. Inventory may still be deducted.
- Multiple payment methods supported via `pagos[]` relation.
- Shared work via `divisiones[]` with per-employee `porcentajeParticipacion` and `comisionCorrespondiente`.
(Previously: accepted serviciosIds field which was silently ignored — removed per Option A)

#### Scenario: Basic registro with single payment
- GIVEN totalServicios=39000, propina=0, pago EFECTIVO=39000, empleado comision=60%
- WHEN POST /api/salones/:salonId/registros
- THEN response MUST be 201 with comisionCalculada=23400, montoPendiente=0, montoTotal=39000

#### Scenario: Registro with propina
- GIVEN totalServicios=39000, propina=6000, pago=45000, comision=60%
- WHEN created
- THEN comisionCalculada=23400 (only on servicios) AND montoPendiente=0 (39000-45000, propina excluded)

#### Scenario: Multiple payment methods
- GIVEN totalServicios=50000, totalProductos=10000, pagos: EFECTIVO=30000, TARJETA=30000
- WHEN created
- THEN response MUST include 2 PagoTransaccion records AND montoPendiente=0

#### Scenario: Shared work (divisiones)
- GIVEN totalServicios=60000, 2 employees at 50% each, comision=60%
- WHEN created
- THEN divisiones MUST have 2 records each with comisionCorrespondiente=18000

#### Scenario: Retoque (garantía)
- GIVEN esRetoque=true, totalServicios=0, totalProductos=0
- WHEN created
- THEN comisionCalculada=0 AND montoTotal=0 AND no montoPendiente is generated

#### Scenario: Duplicate submission
- GIVEN identical payload sent twice rapidly
- THEN second request MUST return 409 Conflict

observations.title: Walk-In Service Registration - Technical Design
observations.content:
**What**: Technical design for walk-in service registration frontend feature
**Why**: Need UI for registering walk-in services; backend endpoint already exists
**Where**: apps/pos-dashboard/src/components/WalkInModal.tsx, apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx

## Design: Walk-In Service Registration

### Technical Approach

Extract a self-contained `WalkInModal` component from FinanzasPage following the VentasPage two-column pattern (catalog left, cart right). The modal opens from the Registros tab toolbar, fetches the salon's service catalog, allows multi-select into a cart, collects client/employee/payment details, and POSTs to the existing `POST /salones/:id/registros` endpoint using `serviciosIds`.

### Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Alternatives | Rationale |
|----------|--------|--------------|-----------|
| Layout | Modal (not page) | Full page | Keeps user in Finanzas context; matches Gasto/Devolución create patterns |
| Cart pattern | Re-use VentasPage grid + sticky panel | List-only | Consistent UX; minimizes new code |
| Component location | `components/WalkInModal.tsx` | Inline in FinanzasPage | FinanzasPage is already 1300+ lines; extraction is required |
| Service price | Use `precioFinal` (not `precioBase`) | `precioBase` | `precioFinal` includes seasonal pricing; matches backend DTO |
| State scope | Local state inside modal | Lift to FinanzasPage | Modal is self-contained; no need to lift |
| Mobile layout | Stack columns vertically | Hide catalog | Service selection is critical; stack preserves functionality |

### Data Flow

```
RegistrosTab ──[open modal]──> WalkInModal
                                   │
                    [fetch] GET /salones/:id/servicios
                    [fetch] GET /salones/:id/clientes
                    [fetch] GET /salones/:id/empleadas
                                   │
                    ┌──────────────┴──────────────┐
                    ▼                             ▼
            ServiceCatalogPanel            CheckoutPanel
            (search + category filter)     (cart + payment)
                    │                             │
                    └────────── add/remove ───────┘
                                   │
                    [submit] POST /salones/:id/registros
                                   │
                         onSuccess callback
                                   │
                         RegistrosTab.refresh()
```

### File Changes

| File | Action | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `apps/pos-dashboard/src/components/WalkInModal.tsx` | Create | Main modal component with catalog + checkout panels |
| `apps/pos-dashboard/src/components/WalkInModal.module.css` | Create | Styles following FinanzasPage.module.css conventions |
| `apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx` | Modify | Add "Nuevo servicio" button in RegistrosTab toolbar; import and render WalkInModal |

### Interfaces / Contracts

```typescript
// WalkInModal props
interface WalkInModalProps {
  salonId: number | null;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: () => void;
}

// Local types (mirror API DTOs)
interface Servicio {
  id: number;
  nombre: string;
  descripcion: string | null;
  precioFinal: number;
  duracionMinutos: number;
  categoriaId: number;
}

interface CartItem {
  servicioId: number;
  nombre: string;
  precio: number;
  duracionMinutos: number;
}

type PaymentMethod = 'EFECTIVO' | 'TARJETA' | 'TRANSFERENCIA';

// POST payload (matches createRegistroSchema)
interface CreateRegistroPayload {
  salonId: number;
  clienteId: number;
  usuarioId: number;
  serviciosIds: number[];
  totalServicios: number;  // sum of cart prices
  totalProductos: 0;
  propina: number;
  pagos: Array<{
    monto: number;
    metodoPago: PaymentMethod;
    referencia?: string;
  }>;
  notas?: string;
}
```

### State Management

```
WalkInModal state:
  ├─ servicios: Servicio[]           (fetched on open)
  ├─ categorias: Categoria[]         (derived or fetched)
  ├─ clientes: Cliente[]             (fetched on open)
  ├─ empleadas: Empleada[]           (fetched on open)
  ├─ search: string                  (catalog filter)
  ├─ catFilter: number | 'TODAS'     (catalog filter)
  ├─ cart: CartItem[]                (selected services)
  ├─ clienteId: number | ''
  ├─ empleadaId: number | ''
  ├─ paymentMethod: PaymentMethod
  ├─ montoRecibido: number           (EFECTIVO only)
  ├─ referencia: string              (TARJETA/TRANSFERENCIA only)
  ├─ propina: number
  ├─ notas: string
  ├─ processing: boolean
  └─ error: string | null
```

### API Integration

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `/salones/:id/servicios` | GET | Load service catalog |
| `/salones/:id/clientes` | GET | Load client dropdown |
| `/salones/:id/empleadas` | GET | Load employee dropdown |
| `/salones/:id/registros` | POST | Submit walk-in registration |

**Error handling**: Display inline error banner (red, top of modal) matching VentasPage pattern. Disable submit button during `processing`. On 4xx, show validation message. On 5xx/network, show generic retry message.

### UI/UX Decisions

- **Modal sizing**: `max-width: 900px` (wider than gasto modal to accommodate 2-column layout)
- **Catalog grid**: 3 columns desktop, 2 columns tablet, 1 column mobile
- **Cart panel**: Sticky on desktop, collapsible top on mobile
- **Service cards**: Show name, price, duration badge; click to add; disable if already in cart
- **Payment tabs**: Same as VentasPage (Efectivo / Tarjeta / Transferencia)
- **Required fields**: Cliente, Empleada, at least one service
- **Success**: Close modal + show toast in FinanzasPage (re-use existing success pattern)

### Testing Strategy

| Layer | What | Approach |
|-------|------|----------|
| Unit | Cart logic (add/remove/total) | Extract pure reducer, test independently |
| Integration | Modal submission flow | Mock API, verify payload shape matches schema |
| E2E | Full walk-in registration | Open modal → select service → fill form → submit → verify in table |

### Migration / Rollout

No migration required. Feature is additive. Backend endpoint already supports `serviciosIds`.

### Open Questions

- [ ] Should we support multiple employees per service (divisiones)? Start with single employee to match VentasPage simplicity.
- [ ] Should propina input be visible or hidden? Visible but optional (default 0).
- [ ] Do we need a quick-client-create flow? Not for MVP; use existing client selector.

observations.title: WalkInModal unified catalog + discount/override + AgendaPage completar modal
observations.content:
**What**: Redesigned WalkInModal with unified services+products catalog and added discount/total-override system. Applied same patterns to AgendaPage's completar modal.

**Why**: User request to combine separate service/product sections into one unified scrollable list, add universal search with type filters, and add discount/price override functionality with required adjustment notes.

**Where**: 
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/components/WalkInModal.tsx (major rewrite)
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/components/WalkInModal.module.css (added .typeFilterRow/.typeFilterBtn styles)
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/AgendaPage.tsx (updated completar form state, handler, and RenderCompletarModal)

**Learned**: 
- WalkInModal removed unused `categorias` state and category filter dropdown — replaced with TypeFilter (Todo/Servicios/Productos)
- Unified catalog uses `UnifiedCatalogItem` discriminated union type merging servicios and productos
- Universal search searches name, description, AND brand fields
- Cart uses a `unifiedCart` memo merging both arrays with type badges ('S' gold / 'P' green)
- Discount is percentage-based (0-100), calculated as `descuentoMonto = subtotal * (descuento/100)`
- `totalPersonalizado` overrides calculated total, shows "+/- Ajuste: $X" in breakdown
- `notaAjuste` textarea REQUIRED when descuento > 0 OR total is overridden — validation blocks submit
- Notas payload prefix format: `[AJUSTE: descuento X% | total $Y] Razón: ...`
- AgendaPage completar modal: replaced flat-discount toggle with percentage discount + total override + required adjustment note
- Backward compatible: `montoTotal: finalTotal` sent to POST /registros

observations.title: Redesigned appointment completion modal to two-column layout
observations.content:

observations.title: Session summary: sistema-salon-belleza-gloss
observations.content:
## Goal
Implement walk-in service registration, price adjustments, product sales, and UI improvements for POS Final salon management system.

## Instructions
- SDD config: A2 (auto), B3 (OpenSpec + Engram), C4 (auto PR), D2 (800 lines)
- Español rioplatense (voseo) for user communication

- NVIDIA NIM fully reverted; all agents use direct DeepSeek
- Commit pushed to: https://github.com/alexander747/sistema-salon-belleza-gloss

## Discoveries
- Backend already supported walk-in registrations (no citaId required) — only frontend UI was missing
- VentasPage is the exact pattern to follow for product handling
- ProductosVendidos field existed in schema but was ignored by use case — now functional
- Cumulative edits can corrupt files (FinanzasPage went from 2726→1555 lines) — git checkout is the recovery method
- Price adjustment fields needed backend entity, DTO, use case, validation schema, and DB migration

## Accomplished
- ✅ Created WalkInModal component (746 lines) + CSS (518 lines)
- ✅ Unified service/product catalog with universal search and type filters (Todo/Servicios/Productos)
- ✅ Added product sales support to WalkInModal and AgendaPage completion flow
- ✅ Implemented price adjustments: discount %, custom total override, required adjustment notes
- ✅ Added 4 new DB fields: precioAjustado, porcentajeDescuento, valorOriginal, valorFinal
- ✅ Created DB migration for price adjustment fields
- ✅ Fixed FinanzasPage list to show valorFinal when precioAjustado is true
- ✅ Added Planes CRUD module (backend + frontend superadmin)
- ✅ Updated SalonEntity: logoUrl as longtext, owner fields (ownerNombre, ownerEmail, ownerWhatsApp)
- ✅ Fixed montoTotal ?? bug → montoTotal || (showed $0)

- ✅ Added total sum display for filtered registros
- ✅ Set default test credentials in LoginPage (duena@test.com / duena123)
- ✅ Redesigned AgendaPage completar modal: 960px width, two-column layout
- ✅ Fixed Layout key warning, StatsCard/Button/Card/Table CSS variables
- ✅ Commit c0bafb8 pushed to GitHub (63 files, +4958/-627 lines)

## Next Steps
- Test end-to-end flow: create appointment → complete with products + discount → verify in Finanzas
- Verify price adjustment data integrity in reports
- Add visual indicator (badge) for price-adjusted records in list
- Consider adding per-service breakdown to walk-in modal

observations.title: Dockerized Node services with hot-reload
observations.content:
**What**: Added Docker dev environment for all 3 Node services (API, Dashboard, Superadmin) with hot-reload
**Why**: Enable containerized development without losing live-reload workflow
**Where**: docker-compose.yml, apps/*/Dockerfile.dev (3 new), apps/*/vite.config.ts (2 edited), docker-dev.md (new)
**Learned**: 
- npm workspaces require all workspace package.json files to be present in the container for `npm install` to resolve symlinks correctly
- Anonymous volumes (`/app/node_modules`) prevent host node_modules from overriding container-installed dependencies
- `host: true` in Vite config is critical for Docker since the default binds to localhost only
- The `context: .` (root monorepo) is necessary so the Dockerfile can access all workspace manifests via COPY paths relative to root
- `:delegated` on source volumes improves write performance on macOS

observations.title: Fase 1: Created registro_productos table and audit trail
observations.content:
**What**: Created the `registro_productos` entity + migration to track which products were sold in each transaction. Updated CreateRegistroUseCase to persist lines, AnularRegistroUseCase to restore stock, added DTO, and updated frontend detail modal.

**Why**: Previously product stock was decremented but no record existed of which products were sold per transaction, making it impossible to restore stock on annulment.

**Where**: 
- apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/entities/RegistroProductoEntity.ts (created)
- apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/entities/RegistroServicioEntity.ts (added OneToMany relation)
- apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/migrations/1700000000004-CreateRegistroProducto.ts (created)
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/dtos/RegistroProductoDTO.ts (created)
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/dtos/RegistroServicioDTO.ts (added productosVendidos)
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/registro/CreateRegistroUseCase.ts (save lines + decrement within transaction)
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/registro/AnularRegistroUseCase.ts (restore stock + delete lines)
- apps/api/src/modules/catalogo/domain/ports/IProductoRepository.ts (added optional queryRunner)
- apps/api/src/modules/catalogo/infrastructure/persistence/TypeORMProductoRepository.ts (supports queryRunner)
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/infrastructure/persistence/TypeORMRegistroServicioRepository.ts (join productosVendidos)
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx (show product lines in detail modal)
- packages/validation/dist/ (rebuilt)

**Learned**: The fake repository mock `{ decrementStock: vi.fn() }` in the test doesn't include `findBySalonAndId`, but the test uses `productosVendidos: []` so the new code path is never triggered. The `findById` query had to be converted from `findOne({ relations: [...] })` to `createQueryBuilder` + `leftJoinAndSelect` because TypeORM's `findOne` with `relations` doesn't support nested eager loads (productos -> producto). The optional `producto` relation on `RegistroProductoEntity` uses `@ManyToOne(() => ProductoEntity)` without a back-reference, which is fine since TypeORM doesn't require it.

observations.title: Implemented Fase 2: módulo completo de préstamos
observations.content:
**What**: Implemented the complete prestamos (loans) module with backend entities, migrations, hexagonal module, integrations with liquidaciones and gastos, plus frontend pages

**Why**: Fase 2 requirement - manage loans to employees and third parties in the salon POS system

**Where**:

1. TypeORM nullable columns accept `undefined` not `null` in Partial<T> - using `?? undefined` instead of `?? null` is required

observations.content:
**What**: Implemented Phase 4 improvements to products module: profit margin, price purchase history, and intelligent re-stock flow with PMP

**Why**: Product management needed profit margin tracking, purchase price history, and automatic price recalculation on re-stock

**Where**: 
Created:

- TypeORM `create()` with DeepPartial doesn't accept `null` for nullable columns — must use `new Entity()` pattern instead

observations.title: Modal dimensions y diseño estándar para FinanzasPage
observations.content:
**What**: Dimensiones y layout estándar para modales del dashboard (FinanzasPage)
**Why**: Estandarizar diseño de modales para consistencia visual y UX
**Where**: apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.module.css y FinanzasPage.tsx

## Dimensiones de modales
- **modalContent**: max-width 500px (default, modales pequeños)
- **modalContentWide**: max-width 720px (modales medianos)
- **modalContentXl**: max-width 1100px (modales de detalle con mucha info, ej: RenderRegistroDetail)

## Layout del modal (CRÍTICO - siempre usar este patrón)
`.modalContent { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 80vh; }`
`.modalHeader { flex-shrink: 0; }` — siempre visible arriba (título + X)
`.modalBody { overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; min-height: 0; scrollbar-width: thin; }` — solo el body scrollea
`.modalFooter { flex-shrink: 0; }` — siempre visible abajo (botones de acción)

## Posicionamiento del overlay
`.modalOverlay { 
  position: fixed; inset: 0; 
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center;
  padding: 12vh 1rem 2rem; 
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  z-index: 200; 
}`
Esto asegura que el modal no quede pegado al header del sidebar (12vh de espacio arriba).

## Diseño compacto del detalle (RenderRegistroDetail)
- Espaciado entre secciones: 0.75rem
- Header: badges pequeñas (fontSize 0.6rem, padding 0.15rem 0.45rem)
- Cliente/Empleada: sin avatares grandes, icono + texto en línea (fontSize 0.8rem)
- Servicio card: padding 0.6rem 0.9rem, monto fontSize 1rem
- Productos miniCards: padding 0.4rem 0.6rem
- Resumen + Comisiones: combinados en 2 columnas
- Pagos: lista simple con icono (no cards animados)
- Divisiones: texto inline con pipes |

observations.title: Session summary: sistema-salon-belleza-gloss
observations.content:
## Goal
Implementar y corregir múltiples módulos del sistema POS para salón de belleza: préstamos, branding dinámico, productos v2, mejoras en finanzas y UX de modales.

## Instructions
- Usar UTC para todas las comparaciones de fechas (toISODate con getUTC*)
- Modal estándar: flex column con header/body/footer, max-height 80vh, overlay padding 12vh top
- Los modales deben tener header sticky y body scrollable

## Discoveries
- `new Date("2026-06-08")` en UTC = medianoche, pero registros creados después quedan fuera del rango
- `toISODate` con `getFullYear/getMonth/getDate` devuelve fecha local, pero backend opera en UTC
- `@Column({ default: () => 'CURRENT_DATE' })` genera SQL inválido en MySQL (necesita paréntesis)
- TypeORM `findOneBy` no carga relaciones - usar `findOne({ where: { id }, relations: [...] })`
- `liquidacionRepo.create` sin queryRunner rompe la transacción

## Accomplished
- ✅ Módulo préstamos completo (backend hexagonal + frontend)
- ✅ Branding dinámico: sidebar muestra nombre del salón, sidebar colapsable con localStorage
- ✅ Productos v2: margenGanancia, ProductoPrecioHistorico, re-stock con PMP
- ✅ Líneas de productos vendidos (registro_productos entity + migración)
- ✅ Paginación en servicios (backend + frontend)
- ✅ Gastos en resumen diario (totalGastos + balanceNeto)
- ✅ Bugfix liquidación: fechas setHours(23:59:59), campos fechaDesde/fechaHasta vs periodoInicio/periodoFin
- ✅ Bugfix liquidación: duplicados bloqueados + transacción atómica
- ✅ Bugfix liquidación: nomina pendiente filtra registros después de última liquidación
- ✅ Bugfix disponibilidad: timeStrToMinutes('00:00') interpretado como 1440 (medianoche)
- ✅ Bugfix préstamos: auth check usaba data?.user en vez de data directamente
- ✅ Bugfix fechas: toISODate ahora usa getUTC*()
- ✅ Modal pre-liquidación con detalle de servicios, productos, comisiones, préstamos
- ✅ Modal detalle registro: rediseñado, compacto, con header sticky
- ✅ Estándar de modales documentado en Engram
- ✅ Proyecto subido a GitHub

## Next Steps
- Probar flujo completo de liquidación con descuentos de préstamos
- Agregar más empleadas con diferentes roles para testing
- Configurar horarios personalizados por salón desde el mantenedor

## Relevant Files
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/liquidacion/LiquidarEmpleadaUseCase.ts
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/liquidacion/NominaPendienteUseCase.ts
- apps/api/src/modules/agenda/application/services/DisponibilidadService.ts
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/PrestamosPage.tsx
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.module.css
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/components/LuxeLayout.tsx

observations.title: Fixed 4 bugs in DashboardPage.tsx
observations.content:

**Why**: Dashboard showed empty data because clientes/empleadas endpoints return {data, meta} but code expected a plain array; toISODate/getMonday used local timezone causing date mismatches; FinanzasResumen type was missing totalGastos/balanceNeto fields the backend already returns.
**Where**: apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx — lines 38-47 (type), 103-108 (toISODate), 110-117 (getMonday), 119-125 (getWeekDays), 365-377 (clientes/empleadas response handling)

observations.title: DashboardPage: fixes para mostrar datos reales
observations.content:
**What**: Corregidos 4 bugs en DashboardPage para que muestre datos reales
**Why**: El dashboard siempre se veía vacío por problemas de parsing y timezone
**Where**: apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx

## Bugs corregidos
1. **Clientes/empleadas vacíos**: El API devuelve `{data: [...], meta: {...}}` (paginated), pero el código esperaba un array directo. Ahora extrae `raw?.data ?? []`.
2. **toISODate usaba fecha local**: Cambiado a `getUTCFullYear/getUTCMonth/getUTCDate` para consistencia con el backend que opera en UTC.
3. **getMonday/getWeekDays usaban fecha local**: Cambiados a `Date.UTC(...)` con métodos UTC.

observations.title: Fixed cliente name display and weekly chart in DashboardPage
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed two bugs in DashboardPage.tsx (cliente name resolution and weekly activity chart)

**Why**: User reported "próximas citas muestra cliente #" and "actividad semanal no se ve reflejada"

**Where**: apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx

**Bug 1 — "Cliente #N"**: The API returns `clienteId` as flat number (no `cliente` object). Previously names resolved from `clientesMapRef.current` — a `useRef` populated during fetch. If clientes API call failed or timing was off, ref stayed empty and all appointments showed "Cliente #". Fixed by computing `clientesMap` from the reactive `clientes` *state* via `useMemo`, and passing it to `CitaRow` which resolves names at render time. Added `clienteId` to `CitaDashboard` interface.

**Bug 2 — Weekly chart always zero**: Chart counted ALL citas including CANCELADA. Fixed by adding `&& c.estado !== 'CANCELADA'` filter. Also changed misleading empty message from "Conectá el módulo de finanzas" → "No hay citas esta semana".

observations.title: Fixed Colombia timezone mismatch in todayStr for resumen API
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed timezone bug where `todayStr` was computed using UTC date but the backend `ResumenDiaUseCase` expects a Colombia date (UTC-5). Added `getColombiaToday()` helper and used it for `todayStr` in DashboardPage and FinanzasPage.

**Why**: The resumen API (finanzas/resumen) was called with `fecha` param in UTC date. The backend converts this to Colombia day range (05:00 UTC to 05:00 UTC next day). After ~7 PM Colombia time (when UTC rolls over), the UTC date becomes the next day, causing the backend to search the wrong 24h range and return $0.

**Where**: 
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx — added getColombiaToday(), changed todayStr
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx — added getColombiaToday(), changed todayStr in RegistrosTab and ReportesTab

**Learned**: `toISODate` uses UTC methods which is fine for internal date comparisons but wrong for sending dates to a Colombia-timezone-aware backend. The backend ResumenDiaUseCase already handles Colombia timezone correctly by using 05:00 UTC as day boundary.

observations.title: Backend Colombia timezone helper + fixed date fallbacks
observations.content:
**What**: Created shared Colombia timezone utility and fixed backend date fallbacks to use Colombia timezone (UTC-5) instead of UTC.

**Why**: The backend was computing "today" dates using `new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)` which gives UTC date. When the server is in UTC (Docker default), after 7 PM Colombia time the UTC date rolls over, causing queries to search the wrong 24h range. The backend is now the source of truth for Colombia date computations.

**Where**: 
- apps/api/src/shared/colombia-date.ts — NEW utility with getColombiaDateString(), colombiaDayStartUTC(), colombiaDayEndUTC()
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/reporte/ResumenDiaUseCase.ts — uses getColombiaDateString() as fallback
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/presentation/controllers/ReporteController.ts — uses getColombiaDateString() as fallback

**Learned**: No frontend timezone logic needed. The backend always computes Colombia dates server-side. Frontend sends whatever date the user picks (or empty), and backend resolves "today" in Colombia timezone. This is mobile-app ready.

observations.title: Deleted 2 COMPLETADA citas from today (June 10)
observations.content:
**What**: Deleted two COMPLETADA citas from today (IDs 4 and 5) directly from DB

**Why**: User requested to remove closed appointments from today

**Where**: citas table (IDs 4, 5), citas_servicios junction table cleanup

**Learned**: Registros_servicio table doesn't have a citaId FK — citas and registros are independent. COMPLETADA citas don't automatically create registros; registros are created via separate flow (CreateRegistroUseCase).

observations.title: Fixed totalIngresos in ResumenDiaUseCase to use valorFinal (post-discount)
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed `totalIngresos` calculation in ResumenDiaUseCase to use `valorFinal` instead of raw `totalServicios + totalProductos`. Now it sums `valorFinal - propina` per registro, so discounts applied via valorFinal are reflected correctly.

**Why**: When a service has a discount (e.g., 50% off), the registro stores `totalServicios` as the raw pre-discount amount but `valorFinal` as the actual amount charged. The resumen was showing $400k instead of $300k for two services (one full price, one at 50%).

**Where**: apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/reporte/ResumenDiaUseCase.ts

**Learned**: `totalServicios` = raw pre-discount (volume metric), kept as-is. `totalIngresos` = actual income = sum of valorFinal - propina per registro.

observations.title: Proportional discount calculation in ResumenDiaUseCase
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed ResumenDiaUseCase to apply discounts proportionally to servicios/productos, and renamed card labels

**Why**: totalServicios was showing raw pre-discount values ($400k) instead of post-discount ($300k). The discount was only reflected in valorFinal but no one used it.

**Where**: 
- apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/reporte/ResumenDiaUseCase.ts — proportional adjustment
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx — renamed label
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx — renamed label

**How**: For each registro, computes proporcion = (valorFinal - propina) / (montoTotal - propina). When no discount, proporcion = 1. When 50% off on serv+prod, proporcion = 0.5. Applies proportion to both totalServicios and totalProductos. totalIngresos = adjustedServicios + adjustedProductos.

**Learned**: The discount is applied only to (servicios + productos), not to propina. The frontend sends raw values and valorFinal separately. Proportional adjustment is the cleanest way to maintain consistency between serv/prod/ingresos.

observations.title: Removed Servicios and Total Original columns from historial table
observations.content:
**What**: Removed "Servicios" and "Total Original" columns from the registros historial table in FinanzasPage

**Why**: User requested to clean up the table layout

**Where**: apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx — removed 2 `<th>` and their corresponding `<td>` cells

**Learned**: The table had 14 columns; now has 12. Removed columns that showed redundant or pre-discount values now that the resumen cards show adjusted amounts.

observations.title: Fixed anulacion display in FinanzasPage historial table
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed anulacion display in FinanzasPage historial table. Added "Anulado" status badge, hides Anular button for already-anulados, and fixes calcTotal to return 0 for anulados.

**Why**: When a registro is anulado, the backend does a soft-void (montoTotal=0, prepends [ANULADO] to notas) but there's no explicit estado field. The frontend was always showing "Activo" status and keeping the Anular button enabled.

**Where**: 
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx — status badge, Anular button visibility, calcTotal
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.module.css — added .badgeEliminado class

**Learned**: Anulacion is detected by montoTotal === 0 AND notas.includes('[ANULADO]'). The calcTotal function was falling back to raw totalServicios+totalProductos when montoTotal was 0, incorrectly showing non-zero totals for anulados.

observations.title: Bug: ResumenDia incluye registros ANULADOS
observations.content:
**What**: Los registros con estado ANULADO se incluyen en el cálculo de ResumenDiaUseCase, inflando los totales
**Why**: AnularRegistroUseCase pone montoTotal=0 pero NO limpia totalServicios/totalProductos. Al calcular proporción con baseBruta=0, el fallback da proporcion=1, sumando todo el servicio bruto del registro anulado
**Where**: apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/reporte/ResumenDiaUseCase.ts
**Learned**: Siempre filtrar por estado antes de agregar en resúmenes. Los registros anulados deben excluirse completamente.

observations.title: Fix: Excluir registros ANULADOS del resumen diario
observations.content:
**What**: Agregado filtro para saltear registros con estado 'ANULADO' en ResumenDiaUseCase
**Why**: Los registros anulados tenían montoTotal=0 pero totalServicios intacto, causando que la proporción diera 1 y se sumara el servicio completo del registro anulado
**Where**: apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/reporte/ResumenDiaUseCase.ts
**Learned**: También corregí cantidadAtenciones para filtrar anulados. El campo estado ya estaba en el DTO.

observations.title: Bug: cita creada no aparece en calendario + falso crash backend
observations.content:
**What**: Usuario creó cita para el día 14, no se ve en el calendario; al intentar crear otra en misma fecha/hora el backend pareció caerse
**Why**: El backend corre en Docker (posfinal-api) y no se cayó — los logs muestran 'Conflicto con cita existente' (422). El problema real es que la cita creada no aparece en el calendario. Posible causa: timezone en la query del calendario, formato de fecha, o filtro de estado.
**Where**: apps/api/src/modules/agenda/, apps/pos-dashboard calendario
**Learned**: API container is posfinal-api on port 3001, not local tsx process.

observations.title: Bug: Agenda no muestra citas del último día de la semana por timezone
observations.content:
**What**: El frontend envía `desde` y `hasta` como strings `YYYY-MM-DD` a `/agenda/citas`. El backend hace `new Date('2026-06-14')` que da UTC midnight, por lo que una cita a las 13:30 UTC del 14 queda FUERA del rango cuando `hasta=2026-06-14`.
**Why**: La query del calendario trata fechas locales como UTC. El create sí manda ISO con `new Date(`${fecha}T${hora}:00`).toISOString()` (correcto), pero el list usa fechas planas.
**Where**: apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/AgendaPage.tsx fetchCitas
**Learned**: Verifiqué con curl: `desde=2026-06-08&hasta=2026-06-14` devuelve 3 citas (del 10), no incluye la del 14 a las 13:30. Con `hasta=2026-06-14T23:59:59.999Z` sí aparece.

observations.title: Fix: Filtrar registros ANULADOS en reportes y liquidación
observations.content:
**What**: Agregados filtros de estado ANULADO en ROIMensualUseCase, CierreTurnoUseCase, NominaPendienteUseCase y LiquidarEmpleadaUseCase
**Why**: Los registros anulados seguían contribuyendo a ingresos mensuales, servicios realizados en cierre de turno, y potencialmente afectando liquidaciones. AnularRegistroUseCase pone estaPagadaEmpleada=true, pero es más robusto filtrar por estado explícitamente.
**Where**: apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/reporte/ROIMensualUseCase.ts, CierreTurnoUseCase.ts; apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/liquidacion/NominaPendienteUseCase.ts, LiquidarEmpleadaUseCase.ts
**Learned**: ResumenDiaUseCase ya fue corregido previamente. ListRegistrosUseCase mantiene anulados visibles en la lista (intencional).

observations.title: Bug: Atenciones cuenta ventas de productos como atenciones
observations.content:
**What**: El resumen del día muestra 3 atenciones cuando solo hubo 1 servicio; los otros 2 registros son ventas de productos puros
**Why**: cantidadAtenciones en ResumenDiaUseCase cuenta todos los registros no anulados, debería contar solo registros con totalServicios > 0 (servicios realizados)
**Where**: apps/api/src/modules/finanzas/application/use-cases/reporte/ResumenDiaUseCase.ts
**Learned**: En el contexto del salón, 'atención' = servicio; productos vendidos tienen su propia métrica

observations.title: Tarea: bloquear edición de precios de servicios, agregar descuento en Ventas, verificar Completar Cita
observations.content:
**What**: Usuario solicita: (1) precios de servicios en Finanzas/Registrar servicio no editables directamente, solo por descuento o ajuste total; (2) agregar descuento y ajuste total en Ventas; (3) verificar que Agenda/Completar Cita aplique la misma lógica
**Why**: Permitir editar precios de servicios directamente rompe trazabilidad; descuento/ajuste total deben ser la única forma de modificar precio
**Where**: apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/FinanzasPage.tsx, VentasPage.tsx, AgendaPage.tsx
**Learned**: Necesito inspeccionar los 3 flujos para entender si comparten lógica o son independientes

observations.title: Consistent pricing logic across Finanzas/Ventas/Agenda pages
observations.content:
**What**: Implemented consistent pricing logic across three POS dashboard flows: Finanzas/Registrar servicio (WalkInModal), Ventas, and Agenda/Completar Cita.

**Why**: User requested price traceability and consistency — service prices should be read-only, only editable via Descuento (%) or Ajustar valor total toggle. The API payload now uniformly includes porcentajeDescuento, precioAjustado, valorOriginal, and valorFinal.

**Where**: 
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/components/WalkInModal.tsx — removed editable price input, replaced with read-only display
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/VentasPage.tsx — added discount/adjustment controls and propina input, refactored calculations, updated payload
- apps/pos-dashboard/src/pages/AgendaPage.tsx — made service prices read-only in Completar modal, removed unused onUpdatePrecio prop
